mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with rising corporate earnings and positive equity market sentiment, driving S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and decline in UNRATE indicates a tight labor market with aggressive monetary policy, increasing recession risks and reducing corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth and increasing recession fears, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is declining, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) reflects a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.5% year-over-year for three consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates demand-supply mismatch, causing supply chain disruptions and inflationary pressures that reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises and INDPRO falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), elevated discount rates and reduced corporate investment cause S&P 500 underperformance, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
